title: AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: AReA：用于高效高分辨率扩散变换器的自适应感受野注意力机制

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种无需训练的自适应感受野注意力机制AReA，用于高效生成高分辨率图像。 Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的自适应感受野注意力机制 AReA，用于高效生成高分辨率图像。生成分辨率超出扩散变换器（DiTs）训练分辨率的图像仍然具有挑战性，因为随着分辨率的提高，标记数量会迅速增长，全注意力机制的计算成本会变得高昂，且输出常常出现结构失真和细节退化问题。 我们发现均匀的全注意力机制是这两个问题的共同根源。 在每一步都关注所有标记会导致二次计算成本，并使模型接触到超出训练范围的更多标记和相对距离，从而将模型推离其分布范围。 我们观察到，在去噪过程中，注意力的有效感受野会逐渐缩小：从早期步骤中用于构建结构的全局感受野，转变为后期步骤中用于优化细节的局部感受野。 我们提出了 AReA——一种无需训练的注意力机制，其感受野会随着去噪过程的推进而从粗略逐渐变为精细。 在早期步骤中，AReA 对下采样的键和值应用跨尺度的粗略注意力以捕捉全局上下文；而在后期步骤中，它则在逐步缩小的窗口内应用局部注意力。 实验表明，无需额外参数或训练，AReA 在不同目标分辨率和各种模型上均能持续超越当前最先进的无训练基线方法，同时速度更快、效率更高。
